meta.description: Innovation (Carl Chudyk) base-game card catalog. Editions: "3" = 3rd edition (Asmadi 2016, same card list as Deluxe); "4" = 4th edition (Asmadi 2025, adds age 11).
meta.slotNotes: Base cards have 4 icon slots: top-left, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right. Exactly one slot per base card is "hex" (the hexagon/age image). No base card has a blank slot (null would denote one). BGA spot_1..spot_4 map to TL,BL,BC,BR; BGA spot_5 (top-right) and spot_6 (top-center) are expansion-only.
meta.iconNote: Keys are the traditional 1E-3E names; values are the 4th-edition official names (asmadigames.com uses these). hex = hexagon image slot.
meta.textTokens: [N] = a card of age/value N (the age-number glyph); {icon} = icon glyph. "I demand" prefix marks demand effects. No base card in any edition has an "I compel" effect (Artifacts-only).
meta.kinds: demand = I demand (not shared, targets opponents with fewer featured icons); nonDemand = shared effect.
sources: https://github.com/micahstairs/bga-innovation (branch main-4): material.inc.php (text per edition), dbmodel.sql (icons/age/color/dogma icon), innovation.game.php (3E icon reverts)
https://asmadigames.com/innovation/?cardID=B001..B115 (official 4E text, color, age, dogma icon; card images Base1..115.png used to verify 4E icons)
Innovation Official FAQ and cards list, July 2011 (BGG filepage 67894; 1E-era text + icons in TL,BL,BC,BR order)
https://github.com/jrdek/innovation cards/base_game.cards (independent transcription: icons, dogma icons, paraphrased effects)
meta.difficultyHeuristic: Weighted flag sum + 0.5 per extra effect + text length; easy < 2.5 <= medium < 5 <= hard. Heuristic only.

specialAchievements.name: Empire

condition.3: Claim this special achievement immediately if you have three or more icons of all six types: {crown} {leaf} {lightbulb} {castle} {factory} {clock}
condition.4: Claim this special achievement at the end of any action if you have at least three icons of each of these six types: {crown} {leaf} {lightbulb} {castle} {factory} {clock}

specialAchievements.name: Monument

condition.3: Claim this special achievement immediately if you tuck six or score six cards during a single turn.
condition.4: Claim this special achievement at the end of any action if you have at least four top cards with a demand effect.

specialAchievements.alsoClaimableVia: May also be claimed via [1] Masonry.

specialAchievements.name: Wonder

condition.3: Claim this special achievement immediately if you have five colors on your board, and each is splayed either up or right.
condition.4: Claim this special achievement at the end of any action if you have five colors splayed on your board, and each is splayed either right, up, or aslant.

specialAchievements.alsoClaimableVia: May also be claimed via [4] Invention.

specialAchievements.name: World

condition.3: Claim this special achievement immediately if you have twelve or more {clock} on your board.
condition.4: Claim this special achievement at the end of any action if you have at least twelve {clock} on your board.

specialAchievements.alsoClaimableVia: May also be claimed via [3] Translation.

specialAchievements.name: Universe

condition.3: Claim this special achievement immediately if you have five top cards, and each is of value [8] or higher.
condition.4: Claim this special achievement at the end of any action if you have five top cards, and each is of value at least 8.

specialAchievements.alsoClaimableVia: May also be claimed via [5] Astronomy.
